//A Means To Increase My Power, O Pack Hunter Mine....
 
//Particle Deconstruct, but weakens for all fusion rifles. Gjallarfusion.

I gain 30 Stability and 20 Ammo Generation.

Each of my detonations releases a Taken Seeker which aggressively tracks and then burrows into my targets, dealing 22 ticks of damage, one tick every 0.25 seconds, for 5.65 seconds.

My foes can be afflicted by up to 5 seekers at once, and <yellow Blighted Enemies (Direct Impacts from Witherhoard) /> take 100% increased tick damage.

<bold/><yellow/> ▛ Most of those who bargain with me do not win... ▟
